description:
Cast Not Dead After All by paying {B}, targeting Eternal Witness.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {B}.
When Eternal Witness dies, it and any Wicked Role tokens that may be attached to it trigger.
If applicable, resolve the Wicked Role trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped, and attaching a Wicked Role token to it.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Not Dead After All to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.
